reader_summary.overview: Brett Hagler was on a trip to Haiti after the 2010 earthquake where he saw too many of those displaced by the natural disaster still living in tattered blue-tarp shelters.. What struck Hagler was the need for more permanent housing that could not only offer much needed safety for families. The non-profit startup NewStory is Hagler’s answer to that need.

key_points.text: Brett Hagler was on a trip to Haiti after the 2010 earthquake where he saw too many of those displaced by the natural disaster still living in tattered blue-tarp shelters..
What struck Hagler was the need for more permanent housing that could not only offer much needed safety for families.

NewStory co-founder Alexandria Lafci joins Hagler on this segment of the a16z Podcast to discuss the startup’s social-media powered approach to giving -- and why even as a non-profit startup they think and act like any other for-profit tech startup looking to make a mark..
